badges.label: The Whale
badges.flavor: Goes big and cashes — the house pays this one.
badges.description: Best win rate on All-In picks this season, and a winning one — above 50% on at least 3 All-Ins. Nobody earns it in a season where the best All-In record is losing.

badges.label: The Choker
badges.flavor: Went all in… and all in went wrong.
badges.description: Went all in at least 3 times and lost every one of them. Nobody earns it in a season where every All-In player won at least once.

badges.label: Perfect Week
badges.flavor: Not a single wrong pick all week.
badges.description: Had at least one week with every pick correct and none missed.

badges.label: The Sheep
badges.flavor: Goes where the group goes. Safety in numbers.
badges.description: Takes the minority side at least 5 points less often than the league average this season, further than anyone else (minimum picks required). Measured against this league in this season, not a fixed number.

badges.label: Lone Wolf
badges.flavor: Runs with no one. Fades the whole flock.
badges.description: Takes the minority side at least 5 points more often than the league average this season, further than anyone else (minimum picks required). Measured against this league in this season, not a fixed number.

badges.label: The Oracle
badges.flavor: Bucks the crowd and wins. Madness or genius?
badges.description: Best win rate on picks made against the majority this season, and at least 55% (minimum picks required). Nobody earns it in a season where bucking the crowd barely beat a coin flip.

badges.label: The Lemming
badges.flavor: Followed the herd. Right off the cliff.
badges.description: Worst win rate on picks made with the majority this season, and 45% or below (minimum picks required). Nobody earns it in a season where following the crowd still won.

badges.label: The Comeback
badges.flavor: Started in the basement. Finished somewhere else entirely.
badges.description: Climbed further from their season low point to their final rank than anyone else.

badges.label: Week Winner
badges.flavor: Every week's its own title fight — and you keep winning it.
badges.description: Led the league in weekly scoring more often than anyone else this season.

badges.label: Cardiac
badges.flavor: Never led all year. Then it mattered most.
badges.description: Took sole possession of first place for the first time in the season's final week or two.

badges.label: Best of the Rest
badges.flavor: Buried in the standings. Unbeatable for a week.
badges.description: Posted a week's single highest score at least once while sitting in the bottom half of the standings.

player.prose: You crawled out of a Week 1 grave at -13 points, then hijacked the throne with 55 points and a 32-22-2 record. Week 14 was your coronation: 17 points while the rest of Sunday Bets got cooked. You cashed 10 of 17 contrarian picks, earning Lone Wolf the hard way—not by following the herd, but by fleecing it. Rank 1, five straight wins, and one hell of a comeback 👑

league.prose: Sunday Bets changed rulers six damn times, only for Charlie to storm from 4th to 1st and steal the crown with 55 points. Marcus spent a league-best eight weeks on top, then got clipped by just 8 points when it mattered most. Doug’s plunge from 1st to 5th was a four-spot collapse worthy of its own warning label, while Mike buried the floor at -80 and claimed the wooden spoon by a brutal 33 points. Charlie gets the throne; the rest of you got cooked. 👑

recaps.prose: Charlie slammed down 17 points and stole the regular-season crown from Marcus, 55–47. The damn nerve: Charlie hit his All-In and cashed a 20% consensus pick, while Marcus went flawless and still got shoved from first to second. Doug closed with a brutal -7 and a busted All-In, somehow making Beth’s own All-In wipeout look crowded. That’s the 2024 book closed—Charlie on the throne, Marcus eight points short, and the rest buried in the ledger. 👑

Marcus ripped the crown from Hank as Hank plunged two spots from 1st to 3rd. The new king holds a razor-thin 3-point edge over Charlie, so nobody gets comfortable. Doug ruled the week with 9 points and a hit All-In, while Hank staggered home at -12 after fading the crowd and getting cooked. Mike’s All-In also detonated, proving some bets deserve a warning label. 💀

Hank hijacked Week 12 with 11 points and a gutsy 16.67% consensus hit. He cashed the All-In while Doug cratered to -17 and torched his own All-In for good measure—absolute cooking. Mike busted his All-In too, but still owns Doug 58-56 all-time, so Doug can’t even find shelter in the basement. 💀

Mike detonated his All-In and crawled out with a week-worst -13. Charlie dropped 12 points to seize the season throne at 55, eight clear of Marcus, while Hank went flawless and climbed to 24. Mike’s now buried at -80—117 bets into his Doug rivalry, and even that 58-56 edge can’t hide this week’s smoking crater. 💀

Marcus dropped a perfect +11 and cashed his All-In while the rest of you searched for the damn instruction manual. Hank got cooked for -9 and slid from second to third, a masterclass in turning contention into debris. Charlie climbed to second and sits on 55 season points, with Marcus charging at 47—everybody else is already breathing exhaust. 🔥
